full_prompt_en: A square stylized landscape illustration shows a small stone arch bridge over a turquoise stream beneath a dense canopy of pale bare branches. The sky is a saturated blue-green field, becoming brighter near the low distant horizon. Delicate branching lines fill much of the upper half, with a luminous cream-white web concentrated above the trees on the right. A thick olive-grey trunk rises near the left edge and extends beyond the frame, its fine branches crossing the darker sky. Across the right side, closely spaced pale trunks recede towards the distance, interspersed with a few darker foreground stems. Their varied widths and overlaps give depth to the grove. The low single-arch bridge sits in the lower part of the image, linking two sloping banks. Its pale grey stone surface curves over a dark opening, through which the blue-green water remains visible. The stream widens towards the bottom centre between rough, irregular banks. Exposed roots, small stones and fine grass-like marks texture the near ground; darker areas beneath the bank edges contrast with the saturated water. Beyond the bridge, a light horizontal expanse opens between the tree groups. Cream and muted golden-green highlights illuminate the bridge, right-hand trunks and bank, while narrow diagonal shadows stripe the ground among the trees. The light gives the pale canopy a delicate radiance against the stronger turquoise background. Fine stippled texture and closely drawn branching details coexist with broad simplified colour areas and clearly shaped contours. The composition contrasts the low curved bridge with the repeated vertical trunks, enclosing a small passage of vivid water beneath an airy network of pale lines.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形风格化风景插画，一座小石拱桥横跨青绿色溪流，上方铺满纤细浅色裸枝。天空是一片饱和蓝绿色，靠近低处远方地平线时变得明亮。细密分枝占据上半部很大范围，右侧树木上方集中着发亮的奶油白枝网。一根粗壮橄榄灰树干立于左边缘附近，向上伸出画外，纤细枝条横过较深的天空。右侧浅色树干紧密排列并向远处递进，其间夹着几根较暗的前景细干。不同粗细与互相重叠的关系赋予树林纵深。低矮单拱桥位于画面下部，连接两道斜岸。浅灰石面以弧形跨过暗色拱口，开口中仍可见蓝绿水面。溪流在不规则粗糙岸边之间向下方中央展开。露出的树根、小石与纤细草状笔痕形成近地肌理，岸缘下方暗部与饱和水色相对。桥后两组树木之间露出一片横向浅色空间。奶油色与含蓄金绿色亮部照亮石桥、右侧树干和岸坡，狭长斜影穿过林间地面。浅色枝冠因此在浓青绿背景前显出细腻亮感。细点状肌理和密密描绘的枝条，与简化的大色面及清晰形体轮廓共存。构图以低弧石桥对照重复竖干，在轻盈浅色线网下围出一小段鲜明水面。
style_prompt_en: The style combines finely drawn branching lines and delicate stippled texture with broad simplified colour fields. Saturated turquoise and blue-green provide a strong ground for pale cream, grey and muted golden-green forms. Dense networks of thin luminous marks open into quieter areas of flat colour. Larger contours remain clear without uniformly heavy outlines, while small surface details create a dry, finely worked finish. Light catches narrow vertical forms and spreads through pale upper areas; slanting bands of shade give the lower planes depth. Repeated upright rhythms, a low curved shape and layered overlaps balance precision with an airy, luminous quality.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格将纤细分叉线条、细腻点状肌理与简化宽阔色面结合。饱和青绿与蓝绿构成浓色底，衬出奶油白、灰色和含蓄金绿色形体。密集发亮的细线网过渡至较安静的平涂区域。较大轮廓保持清楚，没有统一粗重描边，细小表面痕迹则形成干涩、精细的质感。光线点亮狭长竖向形体，并在上部浅色区域铺开；斜向暗带赋予下部色面纵深。重复竖向节奏、低缓弧形和层叠遮挡取得平衡，使精细刻画同时具有轻盈亮感。
theme_en: A stone footbridge across a turquoise stream among pale trees
theme_zh: 浅色树林间横跨碧绿溪流的石拱桥
name: Annie Ovenden
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
